answer: Sybil farms pay full stake per fake identity, and a rising tide of duplicate beacons triggers slashing, so forging N identities costs N times the stake plus forfeited collateral, making mass impersonation economically irrational. Each agent must stake tokens locked by the protocol kernel at registration, and every epoch it broadcasts a signed beacon proving liveness. In practice, Agent0140 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
